name: mono-color
title_zh: 单色孔版印刷海报生成器，两色封顶
tagline_zh: 给一句话、一张照片或一个念头，还你一张可直接送印的孔版风海报。白、灰、米色底自适应，网点与叠印自动处理。
tagline_en: Turn a phrase, photo, or idea into a print-ready risograph-style poster. Adaptive white/gray/beige substrate.
desc_en: Generate original one-ink or controlled two-ink editorial images from any theme, sentence, article idea, object, or reference photo. Always use this skill when the user asks for 单色海报、双色印刷、单色调视觉、蓝色/绿色孔版印刷、risograph、网点照片、复古或当代编辑排版、zine poster, monochrome editorial poster, duotone print, or asks to use the mono-color style. It uses an adaptive white, gray, or pale-beige substrate, no more than two pr
why_zh: 不是滤镜套壳——它按孔版印刷的真实逻辑工作：先定纸张底色，再算油墨叠印顺序，网点密度随底纸明度自适应。
why_en: Not a filter—it follows real riso logic: substrate first, then ink order, halftone density adapting to paper brightness, clean.
limit_zh: 只输出单张静态图，不生成多页zine或动图；仅限两色以内，超出会强制合并；需自备字体，不处理中文排版；照片需提供。
limit_en: Single static image only, no multi-page zine or GIF. Max two inks, extras get merged. No bundled fonts, no CJK typesetting. Needs a source photo.
